items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I played, I was in the band when Morris French was playing Trombone with him.

ctx.x: Were you in the band then?

I played, I was in the band when Morris French was playing Trombone with him. And, uh, when we had, uh, the time we made that time, uh, we had that accident, uh, on, uh, Dauphine and, say Rock I think. Dauphine, it was an Italian fella had, he had bought a truck and he didn't, he didn't know much about driving. Well, they had a car, a street car was running down Dauphine Street then. And when we got to, say, Rock and Dauphine, that's where the, uh, you bet with that accident he'd be frozen in the car, the truck…
